key.name: profile
key.description: full uses spring motion, reduced shortens transitions, off disables compositor animations.

key.name: intensity
key.description: Duration multiplier, valid range 0.0 to 2.0; 0.0 collapses transitions, 1.0 is the spring baseline.

key.name: window-animations
key.summary: Window map, unmap and close motion
key.description: Enables transitions on window clones and window lifecycle actors.

key.name: workspace-swipe
key.description: Enables transitions on the workspace switcher and overview workspace actors.

key.name: lock-fade
key.description: Enables opacity transitions on the shield, lock dialog group, login dialog and modal dialogs.
